title.narrative: Cambodia IDF Grant for Gender Sensitive Monitoring, Planning, and Budgeting for Implementation of the Poverty Reduction Strategy

description.narrative: This IDF Grnat supports capacity development of the Ministry of Women and Veteran's to influence sectoral policies and programs by focusing on policy analysis and advocacy in order t improve gender equality and help to reduce poverty in Cambodia. The purpose of the Grant is to development capacity of the Ministry of Women's Affairs (MoWA) to influence sectoral policies and programs by focusing on policy analysis and advocacy in order to improve gender equality in Cambodia. There are grant objectives: 1.Provision of training in gender budgeting , policy analysis and advocacy; 2. Study tour to Philippines to look at gender budgeting initiatives. 3.Building capacity if MoWA technical staff in linking strategic programs to budgets in priority sectors for promotion of gender equity. 4. Identifying key gender/poverty research needs of MoWA and developing research project proposals for contracting out to relevant institutes. 4. Assist MoWA to supervisee group s to undertake focused research that they have helped to develop. 6. Use results of research and argument analysis to develop policy briefs with convincing arguments that advocate for change.
